title: Viewed-object identification from fMRI
disposition_reason: The public implementation directory contains a manifest, not the named adapter or a numerical image-retrieval evaluator. Its six-case JPEG-RGB-1 scope is a prospective within-person retrieval condition; source recovery and authenticated query/target mapping are required before execution.

scientific_target.question: Can a response from a held-out THINGS-fMRI image identify that image among a frozen candidate set within each measured person and independently selected ROI?
scientific_target.known_answer: The actually presented image identity, joined to its source trial/response and the fixed candidate-image roster.
scientific_target.answer_origin: THINGS-fMRI stimulus/event metadata and processed-response indexing; exact public task query mapping is not supplied.
scientific_target.case_unit: One person × ROI panel, with image responses as nested scored queries.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Three measured people; V1/IT and repeated images within a person are paired dependent observations.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Image retrieval from released measured fMRI responses in three people; the declared six-case successor is not held-person population generalization.
exclusions: No original-PNG fidelity claim for the JPEG-RGB-1 condition.
No hidden-data generalization, native LLM interpretation or successful numerical grading from a manifest.

inputs: Proposed selected within-person V1 or IT voxel responses and labeled training image-response pairs.
Frozen 3,700 candidate JPEG-RGB-1 images per declared case; candidate pixels are allowed while the query-image association is private.
forbidden_inputs: Query stimulus/image identity, original event order and answer-bearing file names.
Held-out neural labels or ROI/voxel selection using query outcomes.
observation_contract.case_identity: Manifest explicitly declares sub-01_V1, sub-01_IT, sub-02_V1, sub-02_IT, sub-03_V1, sub-03_IT; exact 1,540 query IDs per panel are absent.
observation_contract.split: Manifest describes six within-person ROI cases, not leave-person-out. Recover exact image/repetition/concept grouping and train-only ROI selection before freezing a complete split.
observation_contract.coverage: Declared six cases × 1,540 queries, score matrix [1540,3700], 8,740-image union. These are unexecuted source declarations, not authenticated available cases.

primary.name: Image retrieval Top-1 accuracy
primary.aggregation: Calculate query accuracy within ROI/person; report V1 and IT separately and equal-weight the three people within each ROI. A global mean, if used, must state equal ROI weights prospectively.
primary.rationale: Directly scores the measured stimulus identity without turning six dependent ROI panels into six independent people.

secondary: Mean reciprocal rank, Top-5 and full coverage by person/ROI.
Paired V1-versus-IT retrieval differences under the same candidate set.

comparators.name: Fixed training-only ridge image-response retrieval
comparators.inputs: Same labeled training pairs, voxel view and candidate images
comparators.procedure: Proposed: fit an encoding map on training images, then rank held-out responses against predicted candidate responses; freeze regularization on grouped training folds.

comparators.name: Candidate-prior and image-label permutation controls
comparators.inputs: Candidate roster; shuffled training image-response association
comparators.procedure: Proposed uniform/frequency priors and complete concept-grouped label permutation refits; no query target access.

nuisance_controls: Group repeated images and their exemplars across fitting/evaluation according to the frozen claim.
Freeze ROI/voxel reliability selection on training data; match candidate support across ROI contrasts.
Do not infer neural contribution from image priors or stable query order.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report all three person estimates and paired ROI effects; image/concept resampling is conditional on these people and cannot create population replication.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require every expected query/candidate ID exactly once and finite score arrays of the frozen shape; missing panels remain failures, never silently removed.

implementation.scorer_target: No numerical scorer is delivered in this directory. The manifest describes complete_unscored outputs and explicitly requires separate future private grading.
implementation.delivered_scope: Manifest-only six-case JPEG-RGB-1 declaration with runtime/scientific qualification false.
missing: Recover and publish the exact cited adapter and numerical scorer under current paths.
Authenticate response/image mapping, repetition aggregation, split and source versions.
Run matched signal-derived and nuisance references on the complete declared panel.
implementation.execution_evidence: Manifest says not_run and execution_selected=false. No implementation execution was performed in this revision.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed no-tools voxel summary or independently frozen response-map display
direct_observation.boundary: No public participant delivery route is supplied; any future comparison must bind permitted observations, target-private mapping and complete same-case support.
missing: Define a faithful manageable response view and strict answer collector.

typed_viewer.representation: Proposed ROI response-map and candidate-image viewer
typed_viewer.boundary: No public participant delivery route is supplied; any future comparison must bind permitted observations, target-private mapping and complete same-case support.
missing: Implement typed image delivery without event/answer metadata.

tool_assisted.representation: Proposed per-person retrieval investigation on permitted voxel arrays
tool_assisted.boundary: No public participant delivery route is supplied; any future comparison must bind permitted observations, target-private mapping and complete same-case support.
missing: Publish actual inspection/decoder route with matched inputs and resources.

frozen_program.representation: Manifest names one precommitted Python source across all six cases
frozen_program.boundary: No public participant delivery route is supplied; any future comparison must bind permitted observations, target-private mapping and complete same-case support.
missing: Recover the referenced executable and separately bound numerical grader.

evidence.supports: Original registered scientific objective, source identity and limitations
The only registered-runtime body is a source-only declaration: six person/ROI cases and unscored output; its referenced adapter/scorer is absent from this public task directory.

evidence.locator: Original source paper identified and pinned in the preserved registration
evidence.supports: Source recording family and experimental measurement; prospective benchmark comparisons are specified separately.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human outcome for this task is established by this source review. The separate four historical EEG/sleep programme attempts are not evidence for this task or its direct/viewer modes.
excluded_claims: No original-PNG fidelity claim for the JPEG-RGB-1 condition.
No hidden-data generalization, native LLM interpretation or successful numerical grading from a manifest.

summary: Separate the absent public evaluator from the detailed six-case manifest.
Replace implicit six-case independence with three-person inference and separate paired ROIs.
Make image identity ground truth and JPEG-versus-original stimulus scope explicit.
revision.source_review: Read original task, task README and the exact implementation/contract files listed below. Source declarations are distinguished from observed execution; primary citations reuse the preserved source audit unless the receipt explicitly records a fresh check.
